quotes.name: Worst Fears
quotes.flavor: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

quotes.name: Fungusaur
quotes.flavor: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

quotes.name: Erebor Flamesmith
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"We make good armor and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that our fathers made before the dragon came."
—Glóin

quotes.name: Ketria Triome
quotes.flavor: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.

quotes.name: Shield of the Ages
quotes.flavor:
"This shield is a true rarity: an artifact whose purpose is obvious."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Angelic Sleuth
quotes.flavor: Some crime scenes' secrets can only be discerned from an angel's-eye view.

quotes.name: Keening Stone
quotes.flavor:
"The new prototype utilizing a rotational axis is marvelously effective: it makes me want to tear my own ears off."
—Ashnod, to her assistants

quotes.name: Sidisi, Regent of the Mire
quotes.flavor: As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.

quotes.name: Peace Strider
quotes.flavor:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

quotes.name: Eliminate
quotes.flavor:
"Cruelty? No. This is necessity."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Gravedigger
quotes.flavor: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

quotes.name: Woodborn Behemoth
quotes.flavor: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

quotes.name: Ivory Mask
quotes.flavor: Made from its wearer's hopes, the mask ensures that those hopes will be fulfilled.

quotes.name: Murder Investigation
quotes.flavor: "Every death has a web of consequences. Our job is to find the spider."

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

quotes.name: Engine Rat
quotes.flavor: In a land of undeath, permanent pest control solutions are few and far between.

quotes.name: Kazuul's Toll Collector
quotes.flavor: Travelers are advised to bring extra swords, preferably shiny ones.

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Return to the Ranks
quotes.flavor:
"It was not rage that made them fight, but honor."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"Morning light, morning light,
Chase away the fears of night."
—Gavony children's rhyme

quotes.name: Bloodfire Colossus
quotes.flavor: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

quotes.name: Herald of Hoofbeats
quotes.flavor: Most dismissed her love of horses as a passing childhood fancy. Years later it saved their lives.

quotes.name: Throne of the High City
quotes.flavor: In times of trouble, Wakandans still look to the throne for reassurance.

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor:
"I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you'd lost your way."
—Iroh

quotes.name: Spined Fluke
quotes.flavor: Its spines are prized as writing quills by the priests of Gix.

quotes.name: Vizzerdrix
quotes.flavor: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

quotes.name: Sprouting Thrinax
quotes.flavor: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

quotes.name: Zenith Chronicler
quotes.flavor: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor: A mantle passed on through sacrifice and love.

quotes.name: Eladamri's Call
quotes.flavor: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

quotes.name: Warren Pilferers
quotes.flavor: "What do they need all this stuff for? They're dead. We're alive. Simple enough."

quotes.name: Dragonlair Spider
quotes.flavor: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

quotes.name: Steamcore Weird
quotes.flavor: Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.

quotes.name: Stone-Throwing Devils
quotes.flavor: Sometimes those with the most sin cast the first stones.

quotes.name: Mysterious Tome // Chilling Chronicle
quotes.flavor: The villagers pored through the old storybook, hoping that one of the tales within might hold some clue to saving the fading sun.

quotes.name: Exponential Growth
quotes.flavor: Most Quandrix students fundamentally disagree with the concept of "enough."

quotes.name: Traverse Eternity
quotes.flavor:
"Know thine enemy. Admirable advice."
—The Fourth Doctor

quotes.name: Purple Dragon Punks
quotes.flavor:
"These guys are young, but no rookies. They've fought and beat everything on two legs in this area . . . except us."
—Leonardo

quotes.name: Glory Bearers
quotes.flavor: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

quotes.name: Temple Garden
quotes.flavor: Karametra's worshippers know that one must plant countless seeds to ensure a bountiful harvest.

quotes.name: Storm Caller
quotes.flavor: He became elder shaman when his predecessor was mysteriously struck by lightning on a cloudless day.

quotes.name: Sunbillow Verge
quotes.flavor:
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Reanimate
quotes.flavor:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Flood of Recollection
quotes.flavor: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

quotes.name: Skittering Skirge
quotes.flavor: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

quotes.name: Firebolt
quotes.flavor: "There's more where that came from!"

quotes.name: Umbral Mantle
quotes.flavor: It harnesses the power of night in a land where daylight fears to show itself.

quotes.name: Candlekeep Sage
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You love the smell of dusty tomes, the flicker of candles during late-night reading, and the old texts that bring to life the scholars who have come before.

quotes.name: Norin, Swift Survivalist
quotes.flavor: "I don't know what it was! Why would I stick around to find out?"

quotes.name: Fortify
quotes.flavor:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

quotes.name: Capashen Standard
quotes.flavor: Benalia has no need for peacocks to serve as symbols of vanity. The Capashens strut more proudly than any bird.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

quotes.name: Bonds of Quicksilver
quotes.flavor: The sea's reach extends beyond its shores.

quotes.name: Lawbringer
quotes.flavor:
One injustice starts a thousand riots. One law stops a thousand crimes.
—Lawbringer creed

quotes.name: Bosh, Iron Golem
quotes.flavor: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

quotes.name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
quotes.flavor: Every life ends, but life itself never does.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Used carefully, material has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

quotes.name: Treasure Trove
quotes.flavor:
"Wealth means power; the power to subdue, to crush, to exploit, the power to enslave, to outrage, to degrade."
—Emma Goldman, "Anarchism"

quotes.name: Rashka the Slayer
quotes.flavor:
"Rarely be the prey so haughty as to hunt the hunter."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Hinterland Sanctifier
quotes.flavor: "You can learn a lot about a place just by asking the land how it's doing."

quotes.name: Sparring Mummy
quotes.flavor: Aspiring to earn their place in the afterlife, acolytes train every day against those who fell short of that glory.

quotes.name: Strip Mine
quotes.flavor: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

quotes.name: Phantom Wurm
quotes.flavor: It died with the forest, yet both linger on in twisted form.

quotes.name: Call the Spirit Dragons
quotes.flavor: The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.

quotes.name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
quotes.flavor: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

quotes.name: Disruptor Wanderglyph
quotes.flavor: Wherever the spores begin to take hold, it crushes the ground to rubble.

quotes.name: Biogenic Upgrade
quotes.flavor:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

quotes.name: Ajani Goldmane // Ajani Goldmane
quotes.flavor: Catcher

quotes.name: Magma Mine
quotes.flavor: BOOM!

quotes.name: Grandmother Goby
quotes.flavor: She wraps the fry nursery in nullwater so the ruckus of wayward mages doesn't bother the little ones.

quotes.name: Soulcipher Board // Cipherbound Spirit
quotes.flavor: Rather than consort with demons, the Quietus Cult seeks wisdom from the dead.

quotes.name: Keeneye Aven
quotes.flavor: "I have no need of a map. The continent itself guides my way."

quotes.name: Staff of Nin
quotes.flavor:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

quotes.name: Key to the City
quotes.flavor:
"Oh dear... We're really in trouble this time..."
—The Impresario, opera house manager

quotes.name: Helpful Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

quotes.name: Nostalgic Dreams
quotes.flavor: Seton dreams of life renewed.

quotes.name: Craw Giant
quotes.flavor: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

quotes.name: Abigale, Eloquent First-Year
quotes.flavor: The right poem lifts more than spirits.

quotes.name: Treasure Trove
quotes.flavor:
"Wealth means power; the power to subdue, to crush, to exploit, the power to enslave, to outrage, to degrade."
—Emma Goldman, "Anarchism"

quotes.name: Rejoin the Fight
quotes.flavor: "I have to fight... to protect the people I love, and to make the world a safe place for new lives!"

quotes.name: Aesthir Glider
quotes.flavor: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

quotes.name: Dying to Serve
quotes.flavor:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

quotes.name: Brightwood Tracker
quotes.flavor: "Many have walked here, but there is only one trail I seek."

quotes.name: Tasigur's Cruelty
quotes.flavor: The cruelest tortures leave no mark upon the flesh.

quotes.name: Niblis of Dusk
quotes.flavor: It fuels its lanterns by leaching the warmth from its surroundings.

quotes.name: Loxodon Punisher
quotes.flavor: The loxodons believe punishment comes in two steps: pain and atonement. They carry a weapon for each.

quotes.name: Cloudblazer
quotes.flavor: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

quotes.name: Scarscale Ritual
quotes.flavor: Some words are too important to trust to something as fragile as memory.

quotes.name: Catapult Fodder // Catapult Captain
quotes.flavor: And they're more than happy to share the wealth.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the wonders of the world, but none of them can rival the sunsets of Wakanda."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Aether Gust
quotes.flavor: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

quotes.name: Gladiolus Amicitia
quotes.flavor: "Guard the king with our lives—that's the way it's always been."

quotes.name: Vibrant Cityscape
quotes.flavor: If you can make it here, you can make it anywhere.

quotes.name: Mardu Hordechief
quotes.flavor: The horde grows with each assault.

quotes.name: Connecting the Dots
quotes.flavor: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"

quotes.name: Last Breath
quotes.flavor:
"Tsk. You'd think those nasty merrows would know how to hold their breath."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

quotes.name: Kingpin's Pet
quotes.flavor:
"Debt and death sound so similar, and thrulls are so hard of hearing. Mistakes are inevitable."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

quotes.name: Tin Street Gossip
quotes.flavor: "The lawmages are trying to hush it up, but I'm telling you—the guard didn't fall off that balcony. He was pushed!"

quotes.name: Carrion Screecher
quotes.flavor: The banished have come home to roost.

quotes.name: Harsh Mercy
quotes.flavor:
"There is no greater burden than choosing who to save."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Canopy Gargantuan
quotes.flavor: Its very presence forces nature to adapt.

quotes.name: Panicked Altisaur
quotes.flavor: Early Sun Empire expeditions learned the hard way that some surface dinosaurs were particularly ill-suited to the caverns' enclosed environments.

quotes.name: Traveler's Amulet
quotes.flavor: The rider set off into the eerie mist, swaddled in armor and laden with amulets.

quotes.name: Packsong Pup
quotes.flavor: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

quotes.name: School of Piranha
quotes.flavor: Some schools aren't worth getting into.

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: Venturing beneath the desert sands, you've discovered an alien power pulsing with inconceivable energy.

quotes.name: Portal of Sanctuary
quotes.flavor:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist

quotes.name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah // Ajani, Nacatl Avenger
quotes.flavor: His pride denied him; his brother did not.

quotes.name: Retaliator Griffin
quotes.flavor: For every eye, an eye. For every tooth, a tooth. Griffins are nothing if not fair.

quotes.name: Furyblade Vampire
quotes.flavor: "Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Entrapment Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

quotes.name: Foundry of the Consuls
quotes.flavor: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

quotes.name: Silent Skimmer
quotes.flavor:
"I watched it pass at a distance. When I looked back to my companions, Najet was dead."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

quotes.name: Lotuslight Dancers
quotes.flavor: They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.

quotes.name: Training Center
quotes.flavor: Between matches, combatants practice to stay in peak mental and physical form.

quotes.name: Karplusan Yeti
quotes.flavor:
"What's that smell?"
—Perena Deepcutter, Dwarven Armorer

quotes.name: Blastfire Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Encase yourself in the most elaborate armor, and cower behind the heaviest shield. I would hate for you to feel helpless."
—Korig the Ruiner

quotes.name: Oakshade Stalker // Moonlit Ambusher
quotes.flavor: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.

quotes.name: Rugged Prairie
quotes.flavor: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

quotes.name: Steelshaper's Gift
quotes.flavor: S is for Strength. A measure of your raw physical power. It affects how much you can carry and the damage of all melee attacks.

quotes.name: Garth One-Eye
quotes.flavor: Mood: A powerful, quirky, curious man.

quotes.name: Command the Dreadhorde
quotes.flavor: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.

quotes.name: Goblin-town
quotes.flavor: The passages were crossed and tangled in all directions, and it was most horribly stuffy.

quotes.name: Anaba Shaman
quotes.flavor: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

quotes.name: Vial of Dragonfire
quotes.flavor:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

quotes.name: Priest of the Blessed Graf
quotes.flavor: The honored dead who lie in blessed grafs are not easily stirred, but the threat of eternal night called many from their rest.

quotes.name: Vulture, Feathered Fiend
quotes.flavor: "A simple plan. If you can fly."

quotes.name: Archetype of Finality
quotes.flavor: She sees mortals not as they wish to be, but as what they will become.

quotes.name: Pore Over the Pages
quotes.flavor: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Vindicator
quotes.flavor:
"Behold your inevitable defeat."
—Elesh Norn

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
quotes.flavor: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Blast
quotes.flavor: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

quotes.name: Arclight Phoenix
quotes.flavor: Some storms never blow over.

quotes.name: Done for the Day
quotes.flavor: Punchy was programmed to do two things: punch tickets and love punching tickets.

quotes.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
quotes.flavor: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

quotes.name: Earnest Fellowship
quotes.flavor:
"The world has enough strife as it is. Where would we be if we turned against each other?"
—Pianna, nomad captain

quotes.name: Indomitable Ancients
quotes.flavor:
"Odum and Broadbark were the only beings mighty enough to challenge the giant Moran the Destroyer. Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep. He awoke as Moran the Gardener."
—*The Tale of Odum and Broadbark*

quotes.name: Phyrexian Ghoul
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

quotes.name: Wary Watchdog
quotes.flavor: Valgavoth harbors a special loathing for dogs, whose mere presence provides a powerful antidote to the fear he craves.

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor:
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean

quotes.name: Mark of the Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"Through your sacrifice of self, you become holy. Through your strength, all will be saved."
—From the Rite of Redemption

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Call of the Wild
quotes.flavor: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

quotes.name: Peel from Reality
quotes.flavor: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

quotes.name: Leech Bonder
quotes.flavor: Some don't know his face, but his pets are a dead giveaway.

quotes.name: Kapsho Kitefins
quotes.flavor:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff

quotes.name: Day of Judgment
quotes.flavor:
「これは公になってはいけない。このような呪文の影響は大きすぎる。制限付きのアーカイブに保管して、カタログ上の記録を破壊しなさい。」
――タイヴァ校長からイサボウへ

quotes.name: Blood Hypnotist
quotes.flavor: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

quotes.name: Delver's Torch
quotes.flavor: "Not all of us have darkvision, okay?"

quotes.name: Stegron the Dinosaur Man
quotes.flavor: "It isss my intention to return the dinosaur to hisss rightful place as master of thisss earth."

quotes.name: Angus Mackenzie
quotes.flavor: "Battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas." —Angus Mackenzie, *Diary*

quotes.name: Little Bear
quotes.flavor: Even the littlest bears joined in important bear meetings and moonlit dances.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

quotes.name: Elven Riders
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes it is better to be swift of foot than strong of swordarm."
—Elven proverb

quotes.name: Citanul Woodreaders
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

quotes.name: Alchemist's Retrieval
quotes.flavor: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

quotes.name: Winter's Grasp
quotes.flavor: Winter settles on the land, and the land prays it will wake.

quotes.name: Mephitic Vapors
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

quotes.name: Thalakos Drifters
quotes.flavor: They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.

quotes.name: Hei Bai, Spirit of Balance
quotes.flavor:
"My friend gave me hope that the forest would grow back."
—Aang

quotes.name: Underworld Connections
quotes.flavor: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

quotes.name: Nimrodel Watcher
quotes.flavor:
"But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies."
—Haldir

quotes.name: Harvester Troll
quotes.flavor: Having no interest in the greater conflict, the trolls continue to prey upon whatever wanders into their domain.

quotes.name: The Legend of Roku // Avatar Roku
quotes.flavor: "You must be decisive."

quotes.name: Riveteers Initiate
quotes.flavor: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.

quotes.name: Golem Artisan
quotes.flavor: Better living through metallurgy.

quotes.name: Go-Shintai of Hidden Cruelty
quotes.flavor: It seeks those with hate in their hearts and offers vengeance.

quotes.name: Crumble
quotes.flavor: The spirits of Argoth grant new life to those who repent the folly of enslaving their labors to devices.

quotes.name: Leaf Arrow
quotes.flavor:
"Those who think the trees shall remain bystanders throughout this conflict shall be sorely mistaken."
—Sutina, Speaker of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Feral Contest
quotes.flavor: The instinct for survival makes enemies of all.

quotes.name: Larger Than Life
quotes.flavor:
"They say Head Judge Tezzeret will be reviewing every invention at the Fair. I made sure to build something that will stand out."
—Jehvani, Vahadar artificer

quotes.name: Twitch
quotes.flavor:
"The flow is diverted. Your path is clear. What are you waiting for—the cave to bid you welcome?"
—Maizah Shere, Tazeem lullmage

quotes.name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
quotes.flavor:
"All the power of a maro-sorcerer, all the mindless fury of a pitlord. He is a perfect servant."
—Geyadrone Dihada

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Eternal Weekend 2022 Legacy

quotes.name: Ur-Golem's Eye
quotes.flavor: Ur-golems once dominated the plane. Even now, they maintain a deep connection to it.

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Sanctum Weaver
quotes.flavor: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

quotes.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
quotes.flavor: "Greet death with sword in hand."

quotes.name: Rootbound Crag
quotes.flavor: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

quotes.name: Angelic Benediction
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor:
"Even in single combat, I am never alone."
—Rafiq of the Many

quotes.name: Day of Judgment
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust. It brought no pleasure, even to a heart as dark as mine."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The same muscles used to swing a sword can be used to feed a burrow.

quotes.name: Raphael, the Nightwatcher
quotes.flavor: "Time to punch in."

quotes.name: Dismal Failure
quotes.flavor:
"Two magi could trade spells all day and never crown a victor. The real battle is not one of power but of will. If your confidence breaks, so too shall you."
—Venser

quotes.name: Nexus Wardens
quotes.flavor: The Summer Nexus is a holy grove in Setessa where the starfields of Nyx glitter in the shadows.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Song-Mad Treachery // Song-Mad Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"They call it the Singing City, but those eerie sounds aren't music. They worm their way into your brain until rational thought is impossible."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Carapace
quotes.flavor:
"Now *that's* a fashion statement."
—Devin, faerie noble

quotes.name: Gargoyle Flock
quotes.flavor: They dive screaming on defensive lines, sowing chaos before the main assault begins.

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

quotes.name: Tempered Sliver
quotes.flavor: The question isn't whether slivers will adapt to a world's perils but whether the world's perils will adapt to slivers.

quotes.name: Warden of Evos Isle
quotes.flavor: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

quotes.name: Languish
quotes.flavor: Life is such a fragile thing.

quotes.name: Biting Rain
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, it is seldom wrong to stay indoors.

quotes.name: Seedguide Ash
quotes.flavor: "May you shade three generations of seedlings."

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Titania's Chosen
quotes.flavor:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

quotes.name: Lyzolda, the Blood Witch
quotes.flavor: Sacrificial rites take place before an audience of cheering cultists, each begging to be the next on stage.

quotes.name: Dukhara Scavenger
quotes.flavor: The teeth marks add character.

quotes.name: Juniper Order Advocate
quotes.flavor:
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

quotes.name: Rafiq of the Many
quotes.flavor: Many sigils, one purpose.

quotes.name: Crystalline Entity
quotes.flavor:
"Ironic, isn't it? That something so unique could care so little for the diversity of life."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

quotes.name: Opulent Palace
quotes.flavor: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

quotes.name: Burning Sands
quotes.flavor:
"Pain teaches lessons no scholar can."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Elvish Hunter
quotes.flavor: The Elves never had a standing army; when battle came, they pressed Hunters, Scouts, and Farmers into a surprisingly effective militia.

quotes.name: Statute of Denial
quotes.flavor: "Pyrotechnic activity of any sort is strictly prohibited. It is irrelevant that today is a holiday."

quotes.name: Feed the Cycle
quotes.flavor:
Sleeping beneath the sumac
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning "death"

quotes.name: Axgard Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

quotes.name: Cascade Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

quotes.name: Loam Dweller
quotes.flavor:
"You know its mood by the plants that spring up around it. When it is placid, fields of lilies flow in its wake; when it is angry, every stem has a thorn."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

quotes.name: Wirewood Channeler
quotes.flavor: "Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."

quotes.name: Living Terrain
quotes.flavor: Some warriors walk the earth. Others are born of it.

quotes.name: Emeria Angel
quotes.flavor: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

quotes.name: Ephemerate
quotes.flavor:
"C'mon, Lockjaw, you left your favorite tennis ball in the Negative Zone again. Go fetch!"
—Crystal, Inhuman princess

quotes.name: Glory
quotes.flavor:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Shepherd of the Flock // Usher to Safety
quotes.flavor: Not all heroes carry swords.

quotes.name: Reclusive Wight
quotes.flavor: There are places so horrible that even the dead hide their faces.

quotes.name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
quotes.flavor: Here the soratami wove their endless plots—graceful, artful, and deceitful, while the unwitting world moved below.

quotes.name: Ashnod
quotes.flavor: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War. Whereas Mishra works in metals and stone, however, Ashnod works in living flesh. She sees all living things as prototype machines; her "improvements" to them make her as feared by allies as by enemies.

quotes.name: Bastion Protector
quotes.flavor: "As long as I stand, so will your cause."

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Cloud of Darkness
quotes.flavor: "We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"

quotes.name: Regisaur Alpha
quotes.flavor:
"Seeing a pack of these monsters hunt together, I'm at a loss to imagine the size of their prey."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

quotes.name: Dauthi Mercenary
quotes.flavor:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Splinter's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Possess the right thinking. Only then can one receive the gifts of strength, knowledge, and peace."

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

quotes.name: Cloudspire Captain
quotes.flavor: Cloudspire's might comes from its unparalleled coordination.

quotes.name: Voltaic Construct
quotes.flavor: The undead may outlast the living, but those who have never lived outlast them both.

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

quotes.name: Staunch Defenders
quotes.flavor:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Might of Alara
quotes.flavor: The combined strength of all five planes spawned creations none had seen before.

quotes.name: Defiant Strike
quotes.flavor: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

quotes.name: Elvish Archdruid
quotes.flavor: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

quotes.name: Voltaic Visionary // Volt-Charged Berserker
quotes.flavor: She finally realized that chaos was meant to run rampant, as was she.

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor:
"Good neighbors make good walls."
—Jakkarak the Maimer

quotes.name: Sprite Dragon
quotes.flavor: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Aether Gale
quotes.flavor: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

quotes.name: Old Guard
quotes.flavor: "You say you're capable of flying. You got any proof of that?"

quotes.name: Dauthi Mercenary
quotes.flavor:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Infernal Grasp
quotes.flavor: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

quotes.name: Razortooth Rats
quotes.flavor: They'll chew through armor, flesh, and bone. They'll even chew through each other if they're hungry enough.

quotes.name: Amazing Acrobatics
quotes.flavor: "Hey, who added these deadly laser beams? Rude."

quotes.name: See the Truth
quotes.flavor: "What is this that is neither future nor past?"

quotes.name: Ondu Giant
quotes.flavor: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

quotes.name: Sceptre of Eternal Glory
quotes.flavor: It burns with the very fire that doomed Szarekh's species, and channels it to devastate his foes.

quotes.name: Faerie Formation
quotes.flavor: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

quotes.name: Ivory Tower
quotes.flavor: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

quotes.name: Gurmag Rakshasa
quotes.flavor: "It's a pity to hoard life essence in a form so weak. Give it to me."

quotes.name: Keeneye Aven
quotes.flavor: "I have no need of a map. The very continent itself guides my way."

quotes.name: Pegasus Charger
quotes.flavor:
"The clouds came alive and dove to the earth! Hooves flashed among the dark army, who fled before the spectacle of fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 211

quotes.name: Seven Dwarves
quotes.flavor:
"The gleam of rubies and my brothers and sisters by my side . . . what more could I want?"
—Brognold the Third

quotes.name: Force of Vigor
quotes.flavor: General Store Faces Thorny Problems, Spiking Prices

quotes.name: Monument to Endurance
quotes.flavor: Loss is not the end of the journey.

quotes.name: Cloud Sprite
quotes.flavor: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

quotes.name: Moment of Silence
quotes.flavor: The silence commemorates not those who've died, but those about to.

quotes.name: Whimwader
quotes.flavor:
"Thought? Deceit? Progress? Now you're just making it hungry."
—Abral, kithkin alchemist

quotes.name: Elemental Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

quotes.name: Yawgmoth's Edict
quotes.flavor: The warping of bodies and souls has become the heart of Yawgmoth's existence.

quotes.name: Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom
quotes.flavor: "Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us."

quotes.name: Eerie Ultimatum
quotes.flavor:
"The ground under our feet is a record of every slight against the world, to be avenged at a time of its choosing."
—Gavi, nest warden

quotes.name: Martyr's Cause
quotes.flavor: Dying is a soldier's talent.

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor: Even Sam's vision in the Mirror had not prepared him. The Old Grange on the west side had been knocked down, and its place taken by rows of tarred sheds. All the chestnuts were gone. The banks and hedgerows were broken.

quotes.name: Life from the Loam
quotes.flavor:
"When there is no one left but the ravens, the Swarm will rise and rule all."
—Lost prophecy of Svogthir

quotes.name: Spontaneous Flight
quotes.flavor: "Amazing! And I was only trying to teach her to sit!"

quotes.name: Ethereal Whiskergill
quotes.flavor: Fallowsages debate whether the whiskergill is native to the Dark Meanders or merely dreamstuff made real.

quotes.name: Elvish Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"Elves often tipped their arrows with a drug that caused a deep but harmless sleep."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

quotes.name: Savvy Hunter
quotes.flavor: "There is food in the wild. You need not be afraid of starving before winter comes."

quotes.name: Divine Visitation
quotes.flavor:
"We have proved we can punish the guilty. But can we protect the innocent?"
—Ayo, leader of the Midnight Angels

quotes.name: Canyon Slough
quotes.flavor:
"I must have made quite an impression."
—The Fourth Doctor

quotes.name: Self-Assembler
quotes.flavor: It sees itself in all of its creations.

quotes.name: Sorceress's Schemes
quotes.flavor: "The price for your meddling is death beyond death."

quotes.name: Tower Winder
quotes.flavor: The tower guards eventually gave up, figuring it was better at the job anyway.

quotes.name: Nullmage Advocate
quotes.flavor: "Our unity unmasks your deceit."

quotes.name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
quotes.flavor:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

quotes.name: Volrath
quotes.flavor: The son of Gerrard's surrogate father, Sidar Kondo, Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece. Now, he is an evincar, or agent, of the Lord of the Wastes. Armed with exceptional magical powers, he plots to conquer the entire multiverse.

quotes.name: Ancestor's Chosen
quotes.flavor: "The will of all, by my hand done."

quotes.name: Digsite Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Dig over there, you bolthead!"

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Suntail Hawk
quotes.flavor: Su ojo es el sol deslumbrador, su grito es el viento cortante.

quotes.name: Rhox War Monk
quotes.flavor: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

quotes.name: Horizon Canopy
quotes.flavor: It was popularly believed, as local legend, that the Hill at Bag End was full of tunnels stuffed with treasure.

quotes.name: Umezawa's Charm
quotes.flavor: "Be ever loyal to your own best interests."

quotes.name: Angelic Benediction
quotes.flavor:
"Even in single combat, I am never alone."
—Rafiq of the Many

quotes.name: Quicksilver Dagger
quotes.flavor: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

quotes.name: Expedited Inheritance
quotes.flavor: Astronomical wealth hinders peaceful succession.

quotes.name: Social Climber
quotes.flavor: "It's all about who you know, darling. And now you're lucky enough to know me."

quotes.name: Signature Slam
quotes.flavor: A lone dinosaur in gorilla territory doesn't stand a chance.

quotes.name: Browbeat
quotes.flavor:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

quotes.name: Worst Fears
quotes.flavor: It's absolutely time for a blow out.

quotes.name: Dimir Keyrune
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: A key that slips through every lock.

quotes.name: Corrupted Crossroads
quotes.flavor:
"Look, and see the future."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Neutralize
quotes.flavor: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

quotes.name: Quiet Disrepair
quotes.flavor:
"Artifice has always stood upon nature's shoulders. Let us watch nature take a turn."
—Freyalise

quotes.name: Cloud, Planet's Champion
quotes.flavor: "It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"

quotes.name: Valkyrie's Call
quotes.flavor: "Welcome, worthy one."

quotes.name: Phantasmal Dragon
quotes.flavor: Its hunger and ire are no less for being wrought of lies and mist.

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

quotes.name: Amass the Components
quotes.flavor: "I knew I'd find a use for all that newt spittle!"

quotes.name: Roadside Assistance
quotes.flavor: No road has to be traveled alone.

quotes.name: Sky Weaver
quotes.flavor: "Let my wisdom give you wings."

quotes.name: Instigator
quotes.flavor: The desecration of their dead makes even the Saprazzans careless.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

quotes.name: Invincible Hymn
quotes.flavor: Bantians believe those who are born into the highest caste and live a life of discipline and virtue can ascend to become angels.

quotes.name: Draconic Disciple
quotes.flavor: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."

quotes.name: Burst of Speed
quotes.flavor: Great generals inspire by example. Goblin chieftains inspire by electrifying the barracks.

quotes.name: Way of the Thief
quotes.flavor: A true shortcut isn't a way other people don't know; it's a way other people can't go.

quotes.name: Slaughter the Strong
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It was a big day for the gravediggers at Cliffside Cemetery.

quotes.name: Ruthless Knave
quotes.flavor: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

quotes.name: The Ninth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "Fantastic!"

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor:
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death."
—Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Terminal Agony
quotes.flavor: His mouth melted to slag, yet somehow he kept screaming.

quotes.name: Power Word Kill
quotes.flavor: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.

quotes.name: Instill Infection
quotes.flavor:
"The results of our ninth inoculation were the same. The specimen was, of course, euthanized before the contagion could spread."
—Vedalken research notes

quotes.name: Skitter Eel
quotes.flavor:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Scrawling Crawler
quotes.flavor:
"We will sow perfection into the soft flesh of the Multiverse."
—Argent Etchings, plate 38, passage 8

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor: Go where only death dares follow.

quotes.name: Cruel Celebrant
quotes.flavor: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

quotes.name: Splinter Twin
quotes.flavor: The clay is nothing without a hand to shape, the shape yielding until forged in fire.

quotes.name: Waterlogged Teachings // Inundated Archive
quotes.flavor: Moldering tomes line rotting shelves. Generations of priceless knowledge fade from memory beneath the waves.

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor:
*Goblin_Welder:* #blessed
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* #gross

quotes.name: Filter Out
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: There are as many ways to travel the galaxy as there are stars in the sky.

quotes.name: Gigantosaurus
quotes.flavor:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Magus of the Arena
quotes.flavor: The magus still hears the roar of the crowds. They're gone, but the will to compete remains.

quotes.name: Moss Monster
quotes.flavor: After the battle, an eerie silence gripped the forest. The losers' remains were lightly dusted with green.

quotes.name: Aven Tactician
quotes.flavor: The aven are admired, for they are able to fly with the dragons.

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Enchantress
quotes.flavor: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

quotes.name: Virus Beetle
quotes.flavor: The Eumidian biotechs were delighted when a mutated malware gene devastated their systems. They'd encourage the trait, so long as future clutches could be contained.

quotes.name: Geistlight Snare
quotes.flavor: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

quotes.name: Telepathy
quotes.flavor: "Secrets? What secrets?"

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "Our dear Madam Mina is once more our teacher. Her eyes have been where we were blinded. Now we are on the track once again, and this time we may succeed."

quotes.name: Glistener Seer
quotes.flavor: "The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions."

quotes.name: Witch Enchanter // Witch-Blessed Meadow
quotes.flavor: Shilgengar's famine once starved Stensia into embracing vampirism. The Dawnhart Coven would not let the same happen to Kessig.

quotes.name: Which of You Burns Brightest?
quotes.flavor: "Let that be a lesson to you, your family, and everyone you've ever known."

quotes.name: Sword of Forge and Frontier
quotes.flavor: This power is tremendous.

quotes.name: Sage of the Inward Eye
quotes.flavor: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

quotes.name: Kolodin, Triumph Caster
quotes.flavor: "Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."

quotes.name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
quotes.flavor: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Recruiter of the Guard
quotes.flavor: Before a cause can have supporters, it has to have a voice.

quotes.name: Clambassadors
quotes.flavor: "Sorry we shelled your village—here's some gold."

quotes.name: Deploy to the Front
quotes.flavor:
"When the door drops, give them a taste of the Emperor's fire!"
—Commissar Yarrick

quotes.name: Dingus Staff
quotes.flavor:
"A sharp conscience is the weapon of the soul."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

quotes.name: Heir of Falkenrath // Heir to the Night
quotes.flavor: The Falkenrath have relinquished all pretense at nobility, losing themselves completely to their all-consuming thirst.

quotes.name: Deathbloom Thallid
quotes.flavor:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

quotes.name: Pitchburn Devils
quotes.flavor: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

quotes.name: Fiery Fall
quotes.flavor: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

quotes.name: Null Profusion
quotes.flavor:
"Some say that time is cyclical and that history inevitably repeats. My will is my own. I won't bow to fate."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Ensnaring Bridge
quotes.flavor: Bridges usually get you from one place to another. This one just gets you.

quotes.name: Tocasia's Welcome
quotes.flavor: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

quotes.name: Triskelion
quotes.flavor:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

quotes.name: Hungry Hungry Heifer
quotes.flavor: Mooo.

quotes.name: Pentagram of the Ages
quotes.flavor:
"Take this item, for instance. How would it destroy us, Relicbane?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Fierce Guardianship
quotes.flavor: "Mindless violence withers in the face of a master's skill."

quotes.name: An-Zerrin Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Ogre Enforcer
quotes.flavor:
"Ate up all of his siblings in the first week. A good beginning for one destined to command."
—Suka, ogre matron

quotes.name: Cryptic Caves
quotes.flavor: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

quotes.name: Retribution of the Ancients
quotes.flavor: Abzan ancestors died to protect their Houses, and they protect them still.

quotes.name: Helm of Awakening
quotes.flavor:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

quotes.name: Lurking Arynx
quotes.flavor: Once it has your scent, it will hunt you from the Gurmag Swamp to Ayagor.

quotes.name: Repentant Blacksmith
quotes.flavor:
"For my confession they burned me with fire / And found that I was for endurance made."
—*The Arabian Nights*,
trans. Haddawy

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

quotes.name: Vampire Nighthawk
quotes.flavor: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

quotes.name: Serpentine Curve
quotes.flavor:
"Math bites."
—Bim, Lorehold mage-student

quotes.name: Squelching Leeches
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Setting foot in their muck is an open invitation.

quotes.name: Plea for Guidance
quotes.flavor: On Theros, the dove is a symbol not of peace but of discovery. Quick wings herald the arrival of a revelation.

quotes.name: Dusk Legion Zealot
quotes.flavor: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Captain of the Mists
quotes.flavor: "I am no mere ship's captain. The north wind is my accomplice. The tide is my first mate."

quotes.name: Essence Feed
quotes.flavor: Eldrazi grow wherever something else dies.

quotes.name: Garenbrig Carver // Shield's Might
quotes.flavor: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

quotes.name: Tin Street Market
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes I stroll along Tin Street and watch citizens busy with their daily lives. It reminds me why I do my job."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Bloodfire Enforcers
quotes.flavor: Bloodfire practitioners train to focus their rage, building it deep inside themselves until they are ready to release it as a devastating attack.

quotes.name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

quotes.name: Selfless Police Captain
quotes.flavor:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Angelic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Sudden Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"There is no secret buried so deep that we will never find it."
—Kurtar, Sultai necromancer

quotes.name: Cephalid Looter
quotes.flavor: "Amazing, isn't it, what humans will throw away when they're drowning?"

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"If yesterday was two days ago tomorrow, will the day after tomorrow be today or yesterday?"
—Temporal Manipulation 101 final exam, Tolarian Academy

quotes.name: Autumn Willow
quotes.flavor:
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains."
—Grandmother Sengir

quotes.name: Resilient Roadrunner
quotes.flavor:
"Chasing the roadrunner"
—Omenport slang for wasting energy on impossible pursuits

quotes.name: Apprentice Necromancer
quotes.flavor: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: The light was grey, for the sun had not yet climbed over the black ridges of the Haunted Mountain before them.

quotes.name: Grim Reaper, Lethal Legionnaire
quotes.flavor: "The corpses have been sown. Now, to harvest!"

quotes.name: Winged Hive Tyrant
quotes.flavor: A hive tyrant's synaptic link is the primary conduit through which the Hive Mind enforces its dominance over a hive fleet's lesser creatures.

quotes.name: Miles Morales // Ultimate Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "You can't call yourself Spider-Man without taking a leap of faith. It's a lot to live up to. But I'm creating an all-new legacy."

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: "Rise with the sun, daughter of Erik."

quotes.name: Rolling Stones
quotes.flavor:
"We spent three weeks trying to knock that wall down. Now it's knocking us down."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Thoughtcast
quotes.flavor: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: On the border of the Chaos Wall that separates the Edge from the Blind Eternities, creation itself still churns.

quotes.name: Valgavoth's Faithful
quotes.flavor:
"That's the one good thing about these cultists: sometimes they do your work for you."
—Winter

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

quotes.name: Ghostly Flicker
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

quotes.name: Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord
quotes.flavor: "Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"

quotes.name: Can't Stay Away
quotes.flavor: Death is no impediment to dinner.

quotes.name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
quotes.flavor: It gathers against the coming storm.

quotes.name: Elvish Lyrist
Demon's Horn
quotes.flavor: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

quotes.name: Jace's Ingenuity
quotes.flavor: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

quotes.name: Invoke the Firemind
quotes.flavor: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

quotes.name: Backwoods Survivalists
quotes.flavor: Paranoia has driven some Kessig communities to hunt down anything—and anyone—that travels through their woods.

quotes.name: Prismatic Ending
quotes.flavor: Right before his demise, he experienced a shattering revelation.

quotes.name: Stir the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Your lungs may not draw breath, but while your hands can grip a sword, you will be useful to me."
—Nighteyes, nezumi necromancer

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor: "Most people believe magic is only a trick. Why change their minds?"

quotes.name: Archon of Justice
quotes.flavor: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

quotes.name: Wooded Bastion
quotes.flavor: The elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood continually expand the palisade surrounding the sanctuary. They hope to one day enclose the entire forest within its walls.

quotes.name: Merchant's Dockhand
quotes.flavor:
"If you can build it, we can move it."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

quotes.name: Apprentice Necromancer
quotes.flavor: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

quotes.name: Searing Flesh
quotes.flavor: Zemoo found out the hard way that "inflammable" and "flammable" mean the same thing.

quotes.name: Thousand-Year Storm
quotes.flavor: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

quotes.name: Youthful Scholar
quotes.flavor:
"Too dumb, and you end up a sibsig. Too smart, and you end up a meal. Mediocrity is the key to a long life."
—Mogai, Silumgar noble

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Retribution of the Meek
quotes.flavor:
"Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Phyrexians spent countless hours unsuccessfully trying to harvest and recreate blinkmoth serum.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
quotes.flavor: "Before I do anything I ask myself, 'Would an idiot do that?' And if the answer is yes, I do not do that thing."

quotes.name: Fountain of Renewal
quotes.flavor: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

quotes.name: Burnt Offering
quotes.flavor:
"My foes serve me twice: in dying, and in death."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Bogwater Lumaret
quotes.flavor:
"You will hear rumors that licking lumarets grants prophetic visions. That is untrue. Please refrain from licking the lumarets."
—Witherbloom student handbook

quotes.name: Fortune Teller
quotes.flavor: TODAY'S FORTUNE: AVOID CHANDRA'S INCENDIARY EXPERIENCE AROUND 11:37.

quotes.name: Wild Ricochet
quotes.flavor:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Marauding Boneslasher
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

quotes.name: Cephalid Scout
quotes.flavor: The more they survey the dreadful dry expanses, the more the cephalids thirst to tame them.

quotes.name: Vow of Duty
quotes.flavor:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

quotes.name: Eldritch Pact
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The Night Serpent tasted the warlock's ambition and savored the dark hunger in her soul.

quotes.name: Fiery Islet
quotes.flavor:
"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang."
—Karvanista

quotes.name: Faerie Guidemother // Gift of the Fae
quotes.flavor: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

quotes.name: Island
quotes.flavor: As your ship clears the edge of Waterdeep harbor, you notice pirate sails on the horizon. What has made them so bold?

quotes.name: Leeching Bite
quotes.flavor: A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.

quotes.name: Hatred
quotes.flavor:
"I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry. And still you will not have suffered enough."
—Greven *il*-Vec, to Gerrard

quotes.name: Waker of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."

quotes.name: Aura Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"Nature has a way of adapting to and overcoming any force that seeks its end."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Displacer Kitten
quotes.flavor:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

quotes.name: Cloak of Mists
quotes.flavor: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

quotes.name: Grim Haruspex
quotes.flavor: "Your enemies may be cowardly, my lord, but one should never call them gutless."

quotes.name: Hallowed Fountain
quotes.flavor: The ever-watchful center of a growing web of eyes.

quotes.name: Interdimensional Web Watch
quotes.flavor: The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.

quotes.name: Crimson Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We wield the fires of rage. War is our blood and destruction our birthright."
—Crimson creed

quotes.name: Disperse
quotes.flavor: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

quotes.name: Burning Sun's Avatar
quotes.flavor:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor:
"The paladins would be wise not to forget about the Pearl Trident. The merfolk warriors have turned the tide of more than one human war . . . and I have no doubt they shall do so again."
—Onean scholar

quotes.name: Radiant Flames
quotes.flavor: The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.

quotes.name: Tradewind Rider
quotes.flavor: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

quotes.name: Exsanguinate
quotes.flavor: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Raise the Palisade
quotes.flavor:
"Did you not see the big 'No Soliciting' sign out front?"
—Iron Man, Tony Stark

quotes.name: Plagiarize
quotes.flavor: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

quotes.name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

quotes.name: Disrupt
quotes.flavor: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

quotes.name: Orcish Bloodpainter
quotes.flavor: Blood calls to blood.

quotes.name: Sylvan Yeti
quotes.flavor: The deeper the wood, the greater its strength.

quotes.name: Carrion Call
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: The natural order is out of order.

quotes.name: Windbrisk Raptor
quotes.flavor: It awakened to gloom-fouled skies and responded with a righteous rage that shook the heavens.

quotes.name: Serra Advocate
quotes.flavor: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Single Combat
quotes.flavor: Some fight to destroy their enemies. Some fight to destroy themselves.

quotes.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
quotes.flavor:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

quotes.name: Seismic Assault
quotes.flavor: Earth arms itself with fire.

quotes.name: Bayou Groff
quotes.flavor:
"Groffs are great for tracking pests through the muck, but securing the pests before the groff devours them is a dicey endeavor."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

quotes.name: Tectonic Edge
quotes.flavor:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

quotes.name: Ashnod's Transmogrant
quotes.flavor: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

quotes.name: Matoya, Archon Elder
quotes.flavor: "Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today..."

quotes.name: Terrific Team-Up
quotes.flavor:
"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Weird Harvest
quotes.flavor: Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.

quotes.name: Spined Thopter
quotes.flavor:
"I appreciate the depravity of noble designs turned to devious ends."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Crux of Fate
quotes.flavor: "Thou art weak, Hraesvelgr—a slithering wyrm who fawneth on the vermin who should rightly be his prey."

quotes.name: Sire of the Storm
quotes.flavor: This storm blows gales through the dreams of mortals.

quotes.name: Circle of Dreams Druid
quotes.flavor: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Open the Armory
quotes.flavor:
"Have no fear. Amy Rose is here!"
—Amy Rose

quotes.name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Blessed by the gods. Coveted by mortals. Beholden to neither.

quotes.name: Catacomb Slug
quotes.flavor:
"The entire murder scene was covered in dripping, oozing slime. No need for a soothsayer to solve that one."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

quotes.name: Stromgald Crusader
quotes.flavor: "The White-Shielders think their code justifies their actions. In truth it only binds their hands."

quotes.name: Pelakka Wurm
quotes.flavor: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

quotes.name: Bargain
quotes.flavor: Bargaining with a goblin is like trading with a child; both believe they already own everything.

quotes.name: Flame Blitz
quotes.flavor: "Blast it, not again!"

quotes.name: Copper Longlegs
quotes.flavor: Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.

quotes.name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a day when you feel crushed by the burden of modern life and your bright spirit will fade before a growing emptiness. When that happens, my dear, you'll be ready for this gift."
—Grandpa

quotes.name: Inspiration
quotes.flavor:
"Day 31: I finally succeeded in my time reversal experiment!
"Day 30: I might have a problem here."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus
